root_idea.summary: The root centers on acquiring something not previously possessed, with a prominent specialization in spoil taken from an adversary.
root_idea.development: The semantic field extends from general attainment to war booty and to derived notions of taking, granting, and seizing an opportunity. غَنَمٌ denotes sheep and goats; its possible derivation from the acquisition sense is reported cautiously rather than asserted as certain.

senses.definition: To obtain or take as spoil; to gain something acquired from an opposing party.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrences are active perfect forms referring to war booty obtained from unbelievers.

senses.definition: A collective term for sheep and goats; sheep or goats considered as a flock or herd.
senses.usage_conditions: The collective noun applies to males, females, or both together and has no derived singular; شاة is used for an individual.

senses.definition: An acquired gain or benefit; something obtained.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a result noun for what is gained; its Quranic plural is مَغَانِمُ.

senses.definition: Spoils or booty obtained in war.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic contexts, the plural denotes material property acquired from an opposing party. In the associated legal terminology, war booty is distinguished from فَيْءٌ acquired without battle and نَفَلٌ granted in addition to a normal share.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To acquire or gain a thing without difficulty, trouble, or inconvenience.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical Arabic use of the Form I verb, distinct from its Quranic war-spoils context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone spoil or a free, disinterested gift.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II is used transitively with the recipient and the thing given.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a thing become spoil for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form IV construction with the thing made available as spoil.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To eagerly desire an affair as one eagerly desires spoil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction يَتَغَنَّمُ الأَمْرَ, expressing eager desire for an undertaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take for oneself, acquire, or gain sheep or goats.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with غَنَمًا for acquiring sheep, goats, or both.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reckon something as spoil, or to take, seize, catch, or snatch it as spoil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII may describe treating an object as spoil or actively taking it as spoil.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seize or avail oneself of an opportunity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In اِغْتَنَمَ الفُرْصَةَ, the opportunity is taken promptly or eagerly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The recovery of a pledged property together with any increase, growth, or excess in its value.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A legal usage paired with غُرْمٌ, the liability associated with the pledged property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The reported name of a certain idol.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare proper-name usage attributed to one authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An acquisition or gain made without difficulty, trouble, or inconvenience.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a Classical nominal use distinct from the technical war-booty sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In legal terminology, property seized by force in war, subject to a prescribed fifth, with the remainder distributed among those who obtained it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is distinguished from فَيْءٌ, property acquired after the laying down of arms or without battle, and from نَفَلٌ, an additional grant to a warrior.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression غَنَمُ الفِزْرِ, ever or indefinitely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This idiomatic expression functions as an adverbial expression of time rather than as an ordinary livestock noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of certain small stars between the legs of Cepheus and the star الجَدْيُ.
One’s utmost capacity, ability, or aim; the utmost one can or eagerly seeks to do.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In غُنَامَاكَ أَنْ تَفْعَلَ كَذَا, the expression presents doing the stated action as the utmost of one’s power or desire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Taking or a taker of spoil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participial noun for one who takes غَنِيمَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sheep or goats gathered together, numerous, or collected into a herd.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: One reported explanation further specifies distinct flocks or herds, each with its own shepherd.

cautions: The QAC verb identity غَنِمْ is normalized to the Classical Arabic perfect citation form غَنِمَ.
The Quranic plural مَغَانِمُ is presented under the supported singular citation form مَغْنَمٌ.
